drhp.business: Atul Ltd manufactures and sells a wide range of chemical products through two reporting segments: Life Science Chemicals (LSC) and Performance and Other Chemicals (POC). The company serves customers in India and international markets, with a presence across Asia, Africa, Oceania, Europe, and the Americas. Its operations are supported by a network of subsidiaries including Atul Products Ltd, Amal Ltd, and Atul Bioscience Ltd, which contribute to consolidated performance.
